description.en: Share your artwork, cup dimensions, and order details.
description.zh: 请提供设计稿、纸杯尺寸及订单要求。

description.en: We prepare a digital mockup of your design for your approval.
description.zh: 我们根据您的设计制作电子效果图，供您确认。

description.en: Review a sample and confirm the specifications.
description.zh: 查看样品并确认产品规格。

description.en: Confirm the approved design, quantity, and schedule.
description.zh: 确认最终设计、数量及生产安排。
